extracted.name: The Milky Way Martini
extracted.description: This deliciously rich and chocolaty Milky Way martini is made with vanilla-flavored vodka, crème de cacao, and Irish cream for a perfect dessert cocktail.
ingredient_lines: 2 fluid ounces white creme de cacao
instruction_lines: Chill a martini glass by filling it with 1/2 cup of ice and cold water.
Place 1 cup of ice cubes into a cocktail shaker. Pour vanilla-flavored vodka, white creme de cacao, and Irish cream liqueur over ice; cover and shake vigorously.
Dump ice and water from the martini glass and drizzle the inside of the glass with chocolate syrup. Strain cocktail into the glass to serve.
